## [1.2.0](https://github.com/Smart123s/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-10-19)

### ✨ New Features

* **Ricardo nem lopot:** unlock Bora Bora map ([8789843](https://github.com/Smart123s/morphe-patches/commit/8789843d29d04f6f013ddcbe8d9069c44906f878))

patches.name: ARM64 support
patches.description: Adds ARM64 builds of the game's libGDX 1.1.0 libraries for 64-bit-only Android devices.

patches.name: Balance editor
patches.description: Adds a coin button below Gameplay Challenge on the tuning screen to set and save the balance.

patches.name: Immersive fullscreen
patches.description: Enables the engine's immersive mode to hide system bars during play, including after returning to the game.

patches.name: Landscape rotation
patches.description: Allows both landscape directions when rotating the phone through 180 degrees.

patches.name: Unlock Bora Bora
patches.description: Unlocks the second map, Bora Bora, by default without spending coins.
